title: CompareRelationIdentityRequest
description: Request body for compareRelationIdentity. Evaluates whether two relation candidates are merge-compatible under a declared vocabulary. Identity comparison is Compare(A, B, V), never Compare(A, B): which qualifier dimensions are identity-relevant is declared by the vocabulary and is NOT carried on the candidates, so a request that names no vocabulary is undecidable. If any identity-relevant qualifier is `unknown`, the decision MUST NOT be `equivalent` (see spec/03).

vocabularyRef.description: The exact ProfileVocabulary version whose `qualifierDimensions` declarations govern this comparison.
